name: PROVE MOM WRONG + BE FAMOUS ! ⭐
desc:
📱 Record videos
🎉 Grow your following
⭐ Become famous!

You are a young and ambitious content creator who wants to make a living out of your online passion. You love creating videos online. However, your mom doesn’t get it. She thinks you are lazy, irresponsible, and delusional. She wants you to get a real job and start acting like an adult.

In this game, you grow your content creator career and prove your mom wrong by rebuying the house you guys owned.

(Use the phone to record videos and after you will be able to publish the videos by using the computer pointed by the game guide, from there your videos will be in trending and are going to generate money which you can use to buy objects around the house)
